query: SELECT DISTINCT d.registrable_domain, array_agg(DISTINCT d.ns_domain) AS ns_list FROM domain_ns_map d WHERE d.registrable_domain IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ind.domain FROM indicator_domains ind JOIN enrichment_bindings eb ON eb.source_id = ind.source WHERE eb.enrichment_type = 'well_known' AND split_part(ind.domain, '.', 1) = $1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT dm.domain FROM domains dm WHERE split_part(dm.domain, '.', 1) = $1 AND dm.query_count >= 5 ) AND d.registrable_domain <> $2 GROUP BY d.registrable_domain LIMIT 10
